summary: The submission reports a preregistered paired confirmatory run (N=600 pairs) under shared_initial_candidate semantics with complete archival evidence. The experimental design, execution accounting, analysis artifacts, and Disclosure Statement are coherent and consistent with the preregistration. The lone unresolved substantive defect from the prior closure review is bibliographic: the manuscript has not been converted into a conventional IEEE numbered reference list mapped to the in‑text numeric citations using the archived verified bibliographic metadata.
critical_issues: References are not presented as a standard IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived verified bibliographic metadata; in‑text numeric citations (e.g., [1], [2]) are present but do not unambiguously map to a conventional numbered reference list in IEEE format.
required_revisions: Replace the manuscript References section with a standard IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived terminal_bibliographic_records and any other verified metadata in the evidence bundle. Each entry must include full author list, title, venue or repository label (e.g., 'arXiv preprint'), year, and DOI/URL where available.

Ensure every in‑text numeric citation corresponds exactly to the intended numbered reference entry (no orphaned numeric citations or unreferenced bibliography items). Verify numbering consistency after insertion and update citation markers if needed.

For any cited record where venue metadata is genuinely missing, label the entry clearly (for example, 'arXiv preprint') and include full author/title/year metadata from the archived bibliographic records; do not leave DOI/identifier‑only or placeholder bibliography items.
optional_revisions: If space allows within the five‑page limit, add a short table mapping generation semantics (shared_initial_candidate vs independent per‑condition draws) to the estimand each semantics identifies to aid reader design choices.

If any archived validator‑audit artifacts exist (even partial), consider adding a one‑paragraph appendix summarizing them; otherwise keep the clear statement that the preregistered 100‑case validator audit was not executed and therefore validator sensitivity remains unassessed.

Optionally include a very short illustrative paired example (one task) showing shared_initial_candidate reuse and the validator trace excerpt, or else cite the exact archived trace file and its hash in the Disclosure Statement for readers to inspect.
